description: Use this to answer 'are recession signals on?' in one call: Treasury yield-curve inversion (10y-2y and 10y-3m), the Sahm rule from BLS unemployment, and real 10-year and 3-month rates after CPI inflation. Each with its official source date. Data, not advice. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.
